1.1: Shivat yamim kodem yom hakkippurim mafrishin kohen gadol mibbeto lelishkat palhedrin, umatkinin lo chohen acher tachtav, shemma yeera bo fesul. rabbi yehuda omer, af ishsha acheret matkinin lo, shemma tamut ishto, shenneemar (Vayikra 16) vechipper baado uvead beto. beto, zo ishto. amru lo, im ken, en laddavar sof:
1.2: Kol shivat hayyamim hu zorek et haddam umaktir et hakketoret umetiv et hannerot umakriv et harosh veet haregel. ushear kol hayyamim, im ratza lehakeriv, makriv, shekkohen gadol makriv chelek barosh venotel chelek barosh:
1.3: Masru lo zekenim mizzikne vet din, vekorin lefanav beseder hayyom, veomrim lo, ishi chohen gadol, kera atta beficha, shemma shachachta o shemma lo lamadta. erev yom hakkippurim shacharit, maamidin oto beshaar mizrach, umaavirin lefanav parim veelim uchevasim, kede sheyyehe makkir veragil baavoda:
1.4: Kol shivat hayyamim lo hayu monin mimmennu maachol umishte, erev yom hakkippurim im chashecha, lo hayu mannichim oto leechol harebe, mippene shehammaachol mevi et hashshena:
1.5: Mesaruhu zikne vet din lezikne chehunna, veheeluhu laaliyyat bet avtinas, vehishbiuhu venifteru vehalchu lahem. veamru lo, ishi chohen gadol, anu sheluche vet din, veatta sheluchenu usheliach bet din, mashbiin anu alecha bemi sheshshikken shemo vabbayit hazze, shello teshanne davar mikkol ma sheamarnu lach. hu foresh uvoche, vehen porshin uvochin:
1.6: Im haya chacham, doresh. veim lav, talmide chachamim dorshin lefanav. veim ragil likrot, kore. veim lav, korin lefanav. uvamme korin lefanav, beiyyov uveezra uvedivre hayyamim. zecharya ben kevutal omer, peamim harebe kariti lefanav bedaniyyel:
1.7: Bikkesh lehitnamnem, pirche chehunna makkin lefanav beetzba tzereda, veomrim lo, ishi chohen gadol, amod vehafeg achat al haritzpa. umaasikin oto ad sheyyaggia zeman hashshechita:
1.8: Bechol yom tormin et hammizbeach bikriat haggever o samuch lo, ben lefanav ben leacharav. beyom hakkippurim mechatzot, uvargalim meashmura harishona, velo hayta keriat haggever maggaat ad shehayta azara melea miyyisrael:

2.1: Barishona kol mi sherotze litrom et hammizbeach, torem. uvizman shehen merubbin, ratzin veolin bakkevesh, vechol hakkodem et chavero vearba ammot zacha. veim hayu shenehem shavin, hamemunne omer lahem hatzebiu. uma hen motziin, achat o shetayim, veen motziin aguddal bammikdash:
2.2: Maase shehayu shenehem shavin veratzin veolin bakkevesh, vedachaf echad mehen et chavero, venafal venishbera raglo. vechevan sherau vet din shebbain lide sakkana, hitkinu shello yehu tormin et hammizbeach ella vefayis. arbaa feyasot hayu sham, veze happayis harishon:
2.3: Happayis hashsheni, mi shochet, mi zorek, umi medashshen mizbeach happenimi, umi medashshen et hammenora, umi maale evarim lakkevesh, harosh veharegel, ushete hayyadayim, haoketz veharegel, hechaze vehaggera, ushete haddefanot, vehakkeravayim, vehassolet, vehachavittin, vehayyayin. shelosha asar kohanim zachu vo. amar ben azzay lifne rabbi akiva mishshum rabbi yehoshua, derech hillucho haya karev:
2.4: Happayis hashshelishi, chadashim lakketoret bou vehafisu. veharvii, chadashim im yeshanim, mi maale evarim min hakkevesh velammizbeach:
2.5: Tamid karev betisha, baasara, beachad asar, bishnem asar, lo fachot velo yoter. ketzad. atzmo betisha. bechag, beyad echad tzelochit shel mayim, hare chan asara. ben haarbayim, beachad asar, hu atzmo betisha, ushenayim beyadam shene gezire etzim. uveshabbat beachad asar, hu atzmo betisha, ushenayim beyadam shene veziche levona shel lechem happanim. uveshabbat shebbetoch hechag, beyad echad tzelochit shel mayim:
2.6: Ayil karev beachad asar, habbasar bachamishsha, hakkeravayim vehassolet vehayyayin bishnayim shenayim:
2.7: Par karev beesrim vearbaa, harosh veharegel, harosh beechad, veharegel bishnayim. haoketz veharegel, haoketz bishnayim, veharegel bishnayim. hechaze vehaggera, hechaze beechad, vehaggera bishlosha. shete yadayim bishnayim. shete defannot bishnayim. hakkeravayim vehassolet vehayyayin bishlosha shelosha. bamme devarim amurim, bekarbenot tzibbur. aval bekarban yachid, im ratza lehakeriv, makriv. hefshetan venittuchan shel ellu vaellu shavin:

3.1: Amar lahem hamemunne, tzeu ureu im higgia zeman hashshechita. im higgia, haroe omer, barkay. mattitya ben shemuel omer, heir pene chol hammizrach ad shebbechevron. vehu omer hen:
3.2: Velama hutzrechu lechach, sheppaam achat ala meor hallevana vedimmu sheheir mizrach, veshachatu et hattamid, vehotziuhu levet hasserefa. horidu chohen gadol levet hattevila. ze hakkelal haya vammikdash, kol hammesech et raglav taun tevila, vechol hammattil mayim taun kiddush yadayim veraglayim:
3.3: En adam nichnas laazara laavoda, afillu tahor, ad sheyyitbol. chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo vayyom, vechullan bakkodesh al bet happarva, chutz mizzo vilvad:
3.4: Persu sadin shel butz beno leven haam. pashat, yarad vetaval, ala venistappeg. heviu lo vigde zahav, velavash vekiddesh yadav veraglav. heviu lo et hattamid. keratzo, umerak acher shechita al yado. kibbel et haddam uzerako. nichnas lehaketir ketoret shel shachar, ulehetiv et hannerot, ulehakriv et harosh veet haevarim veet hachavittin veet hayyayin:
3.5: Ketoret shel shachar hayta kereva ben dam laevarim. shel ben haarbayim, ben evarim lannesachim. im haya chohen gadol zaken o istenis, mechammin lo chammin umetilin letoch hatztzonen, kede shettafug tzinnatan:
3.6: Heviuhu levet happarva, uvakkodesh hayta. parsu sadin shel butz beno leven haam, kiddesh yadav veraglav ufashat. rabbi meir omer, pashat, kiddesh yadav veraglav. yarad vetaval, ala venistappeg. heviu lo vigde lavan, lavash vekiddesh yadav veraglav:
3.7: Bashshachar haya lovesh pillusin shel shenem asar mane, uven haarbayim hindevin shel shemone meot zuz, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bashshachar haya lovesh shel shemona asar mane, uven haarbayim shel shenem asar mane, hakkol sheloshim mane. ellu mishshel tzibbur. veim ratza lehosif, mosif mishshello:
3.8: Ba lo etzel paro, ufaro haya omed ben haulam velammizbeach, rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav, vehakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav, vesomech shete yadav alav umitvadde. vechach haya omer, anna hashshem, aviti pashati chatati lefanecha ani uveti. anna hashshem, kapper na laavonot velappeshaim velachataim, sheaviti vesheppashati veshechatati lefanecha ani uveti, kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha (Vayikra 16), ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu. vehen onin acharav, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed:
3.9: Ba lo lemizrach haazara, litzfon hammizbeach, hassegan mimino verosh bet av missemolo. vesham shene seirim, vekalpi hayta sham uvah shene goralot. shel eshkeroa hayu, vaasaan ben gamla shel zahav, vehayu mazkirin oto leshavach:
3.10: Ben katin asa shenem asar dad lakkiyyor, shello hayu lo ella shenayim. veaf hu asa mucheni lakkiyyor, shello yihyv memav nifsalin belina. munbaz hammelech haya ose chol yedot hakkelim shel yom hakkippurim shel zahav. hilni immo asta nivreshet shel zahav al pitcho shel hechol. veaf hi asta tavla shel zahav shepparashat sota chetuva aleha. nikanor naasu nissim ledaltotav, vehayu mazkirin oto leshavach:
3.11: Veellu lignay, shel bet garmu lo ratzu lelammed al maase lechem happanim. shel bet avtinas lo ratzu lelammed al maase hakketoret. hugras ben levi haya yodea perek bashshir velo ratza lelammed. ben kamtzar lo ratza lelammed al maase hakketav. al harishonim neemar (Mishlei 10), zecher tzaddik livracha. veal ellu neemar (sham) veshem reshaim yirkav:

4.1: Taraf bakkalpi veheela shene goralot. echad katuv alav lashshem veechad katuv alav laazazel. hassegan bimino verosh bet av missemolo. im shel shem ala vimino, hassegan omer lo, ishi chohen gadol, hagebeah yeminecha. veim shel shem ala vismolo, rosh bet av omer lo, ishi chohen gadol, haggebeah semolecha. netano al shene hasseirim veomer, laAdonai chattat. rabbi yishmael omer, lo haya tzarich lomar chattat, ella laAdonai. vehen onin acharav, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed:
4.2: Kashar lashon shel zehorit berosh sair hammishtalleach veheemido cheneged bet shillucho, velannishchat keneged bet shechitato. ba lo etzel paro sheniyya, vesomech shete yadav alav umitvadde. vechach haya omer, anna hashshem, aviti pashati chatati lefanecha ani uveti uvene aharon am kedoshecha. anna hashshem, kapper na laavonot velappeshaim velachataim, sheaviti vesheppashati veshechatati lefanecha ani uveti uvene aharon am kedoshecha, kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha (Vayikra 16), ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu. vehen onin acharav, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed:
4.3: Shechato vekibbel bammizrak et damo, unetano lemi shehu memares bo al haroved harvii shebbahechol, kede shello yikrosh. natal machta veala lerosh hammizbeach, ufinna gechalim elach veelach, vechote min hameukkalot happenimiyyot, veyarad vehinnichah al haroved harvii shebbaazara:
4.4: Bechol yom haya chote beshel kesef umeare vetoch shel zahav, vehayyom chote veshel zahav uvah haya machnis. bechol yom chote veshel arbaat kabbin umeare vetoch shel sheloshet kabbin, vehayyom chote veshel sheloshet kabbin, uvah haya machnis. rabbi yose omer, bechol yom chote veshel sea umeare vetoch shel sheloshet kabbin, vehayyom chote veshel sheloshet kabbin, uvah haya machnis. bechol yom hayta cheveda, vehayyom kalla. bechol yom hayta yadah ketzara, vehayyom arukka. bechol yom haya zehavah yarok, vehayyom adom, divre rabbi menachem. bechol yom makriv peras beshacharit uferas ben haarbayim, vehayyom mosif melo chafnav. bechol yom hayta dakka, vehayyom dakka min haddakka:
4.5: Bechol yom kohanim olim bemizracho shel kevesh veyordin bemaaravo, vehayyom kohen gadol ole vaemtza veyored baemtza. rabbi yehuda omer, leolam kohen gadol ole vaemtza veyored baemtza. bechol yom kohen gadol mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiyyor, vehayyom min hakkiton shel zahav. rabbi yehuda omer, leolam kohen gadol mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiton shel zahav:
4.6: Bechol yom hayu sham arba maarachot, vehayyom chamesh, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, bechol yom shalosh, vehayyom arba. rabbi yehuda omer, bechol yom shetayim, vehayyom shalosh:

5.1: Hotziu lo et hakkaf veet hammachta, vechafan melo chafnav venatan letoch hakkaf, haggadol lefi gadlo, vehakkatan lefi katno, vechach hayta middatah. natal et hammachta bimino veet hakkaf bismolo. haya mehallech bahechol, ad shemmaggia leven shete happarochot hammavdilot ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim, uvenehen amma. rabbi yose omer, lo hayta sham ella farochet achat bilvad, shenneemar (Shemot 26), vehivdila happarochet lachem ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim. hachitzona hayta ferufa min haddarom, vehappenimit min hatztzafon. mehallech benehen, ad shemmaggia latztzafon. higgia latztzafon, hofech panav laddarom, mehallech lismolo im happarochet ad shehu maggia laaron. higgia laaron. noten et hammachta ben shene habbaddim. tzavar et hakketoret al gabbe gechalim, venitmalle chol habbayit kullo ashan. yatza uva lo vederech bet kenisato, umitpallel tefilla ketzara babbayit hachitzon, velo haya maarich bitfillato, shello lehaveit et yisrael:
5.2: Mishshennittal haaron, even hayta sham mimot neviim rishonim, ushetiyya hayta nikret, gevoha min haaretz shalosh etzbaot, vealeha haya noten:
5.3: Natal et haddam mimmi shehaya memares bo, nichnas lammakom shennichnas, veamad bammakom sheamad, vehizza mimmennu achat lemala vesheva lematta, velo haya mitkavven lehazzot lo lemala velo lematta, ella chematzlif. vechach haya mone, achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim, achat veshalosh, achat vearba, achat vechamesh, achat vashesh, achat vasheva. yatza vehinnicho al kan hazzahav shebbahechol:
5.4: Heviu lo et hassair, shechato vekibbel bammizrak et damo. nichnas limkom shennichnas, veamad bimkom sheamad, vehizza mimmennu achat lemala vesheva lematta, velo haya mitkavven lehazzot lo lemala velo lematta, ella chematzlif. vechach haya mone, achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim, achat veshalosh, achat vearba, achat vechamesh, achat vashesh, achat vasheva. yatza vehinnicho al kan hashsheni shehaya vahechol. rabbi yehuda omer, lo haya sham ella kan echad bilvad. natal dam happar vehinniach dam hassair, vehizza mimmennu al happarochet shekkeneged haaron mibbachutz, achat lemala vesheva lematta, velo haya mitkavven lehazzot lo lemala velo lematta, ella chematzlif. vechach haya mone, achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim, achat veshalosh, achat vearba, achat vechamesh, achat vashesh, achat vasheva. natal dam hassair vehinniach dam happar, vehizza mimmennu al happarochet shekkeneged haaron mibbachutz, achat lemala vesheva lematta, velo haya mitkavven lehazzot lo lemala velo lematta, ella chematzlif. vechach haya mone, achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim, achat veshalosh, achat vearba, achat vechamesh, achat vashesh, achat vasheva. era dam happar letoch dam hassair, venatan et hammale varekan:
5.5: Veyatza el hammizbeach asher lifne Adonai, ze mizbach hazzahav. hitchil mechatte veyored. mehechan hu matchil, mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit, deromit mizrachit. mekom shehu matchil bachattat al mizbeach hachitzon, mishsham haya gomer al mizbeach happenimi. rabbi eliezer omer, bimkomo haya omed umechatte. veal kullan haya noten millematta lemala, chutz mizzo shehayta lefanav, shealeha haya noten milmala lematta:
5.6: Hizza al tohoro shel mizbeach sheva peamim, usheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon, veshel mizbeach hachitzon haya shofech al yesod deromi. ellu vaellu mitarvin baamma veyotzin lenachal kidron, venimkarin laggannanin lezevel, umoalin bahen:
5.7: Kol maase yom hakkippurim haamur al hasseder, im hikdim maase lachavero, lo asa chelum. hikdim dam hassair ledam happar, yachazor veyazze middam hassair leachar dam happar. veim ad shello gamar et hammattanot shebbifnim nishpach haddam, yavi dam acher veyachazor veyazze vattechilla bifnim. vechen bahechol, vechen bemizbach hazzahav, shekkullan kappara vifne atzman. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim, mimmekom sheppasak, mishsham hu matchil:

6.1: Shene seire yom hakkippurim, mitzvatan sheyyihyu shenehen shavin bemare uvekoma uvedamim uvilkichatan keechad. veaf al pi sheenan shavin, kesherin. lakach echad hayyom veechad lemachar, kesherin. met echad mehen, im ad shello higril met, yikkach zug lashsheni. veim mishshehigril met, yavi zug acher veyagril alehem battechilla, veyomar, im shel shem met, ze sheala alav haggoral lashshem yitkayyem tachtav. veim shel azazel met, ze sheala alav haggoral laazazel yitkayyem tachtav. vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava, sheen chattat tzibbur meta. rabbi yehuda omer, tamut. veod amar rabbi yehuda, nishpach haddam, yamut hammishtalleach. met hammishtalleach, yishshafech haddam:
6.2: Ba lo etzel sair hammishtalleach vesomech shete yadav alav umitvadde. vechach haya omer, anna hashshem, avu pashu chatu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael. anna bashshem, kapper na laavonot velappeshaim velachataim, sheavu vesheppashu veshechatu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael, kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha lemor (Vayikra 16), ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu. vehakkohanim vehaam haomdim baazara, keshehayu shomim shem hameforash shehu yotze mippi chohen gadol, hayu korim umishtachavim venoflim al penehem, veomrim, baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed:
6.3: Mesaro lemi shehaya molicho. hakkol kesherin leholicho, ella sheasu hakkohanim gedolim keva velo hayu mannichin et yisrael leholicho. amar rabbi yose, maase veholicho arsela, veyisrael haya:
6.4: Vechevesh asu lo mippene habbavliyyim, shehayu metalleshim bisaro, veomrim lo, tol vatze, tol vatze. miyyakkire yerushalayim hayu melavvin oto ad sukka harishona. eser sukkot mirushalayim vead tzuk, tishim ris, shiva umechetza lechol mil:
6.5: Al kol sukka vesukka omrim lo, hare mazon vahare mayim. umelavvin oto missukka lesukka, chutz meacharona shebbahen, sheeno maggia immo latztzuk, ella omed merachok veroe et maasav:
6.6: Me haya ose, cholek lashon shel zehorit, chetzyo kashar bassela vechetzyo kashar ben shete karnav, udechafo laachorav, vehu mitgalgel veyored, velo haya maggia lachatzi hahar ad shennaasa evarim evarim. ba veyashav lo tachat sukka acharona ad shettechshach. umeematay metamme vegadim, mishsheyyetze chutz lechomat yerushalayim. rabbi shimon omer, mishsheat dechiyyato latztzuk:
6.7: Ba lo etzel par vesair hannisrafin. keraan vehotzi et emurehen, netanan bemages, vehiktiran al gabbe hammizbeach. kelaan bemiklaot, vehotzian levet hasserefa. umeematay metammein begadim, mishsheyyetzu chutz lechomat haazara. rabbi shimon omer, mishsheyyitztzat haur berubban:
6.8: Amru lo lechohen gadol, higgia sair lammidbar. uminnayin hayu yodin shehiggia sair lammidbar, darkiyyot hayu osin, umenifin bassudarin, veyodin shehiggia sair lammidbar. amar rabbi yehuda, vahalo siman gadol haya lahem, mirushalayim vead bet chiddudo shelosha milin. holchin mil, vechozrin mil, veshohin kede mil, veyodin shehiggia sair lammidbar. rabbi yishmael omer, vahalo siman acher haya lahem, lashon shel zehorit haya kashur al pitcho shel hechol, ucheshehiggia sair lammidbar haya hallashon malbin, shenneemar (yeshaya 1), im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu:

7.1: Ba lo chohen gadol likrot. im ratza likrot bevigde vutz, kore. veim lo, kore veitztelit lavan mishshello. chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotno lerosh hakkeneset, verosh hakkeneset notno lassegan, vehassegan notno lechohen gadol, vechohen gadol omed umekabbel vekore omed, vekore achare mot veach beasor. vegolel sefer tora umannicho vecheko, veomer, yoter mimma shekkarati lifnechem katuv kan, uveasor shebbechummash happekudim kore al pe, umevarech aleha shemone verachot, al hattora, veal haavoda, veal hahodaa, veal mechilat heavon, veal hammikdash bifne atzmo, veal yisrael bifne atzman veal yerushalayim bifne atzmah veal hakkohanim bifne atzman veal shear hattefilla:
7.2: Haroe chohen gadol keshehu kore, eno roe far vesair hannisrafim. veharoe far vesair hannisrafim, eno roe chohen gadol keshehu kore. velo mippene sheeno rashshay, ella shehayta derech rechoka, umelechet shenehen shava cheechat:
7.3: Im bevigde vutz kore, kiddesh yadav veraglav, pashat yarad vetaval, ala venistappeg. heviu lo vigde zahav, velavash, vekiddesh yadav veraglav, veyatza veasa et elo veet el haam, veet shivat kevasim temimim bene shana, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi akiva omer, im tamid shel shachar hayu kerevin, ufar haola vesair hannaase vachutz hayu kerevin im tamid shel ben haarbayim:
7.4: Kiddesh yadav veraglav, ufashat veyarad vetaval veala venistappeg. heviu lo vigde lavan, velavash, vekiddesh yadav veraglav. nichnas lehotzi et hakkaf veet hammachta. kiddesh yadav veraglav, ufashat veyarad vetaval, ala venistappeg. heviu lo vigde zahav velavash, vekiddesh yadav veraglav, venichnas lehaketir ketoret shel ben haarbayim ulehetiv et hannerot, vekiddesh yadav veraglav, ufashat. heviu lo vigde atzmo, velavash. umelavvin oto ad beto. veyom tov haya ose leohavav beshaa sheyyatza veshalom min hakkodesh:
7.5: Kohen gadol meshammesh bishmona chelim. vehahedyot bearbaa, bechuttonet umichnasayim umitznefet veavnet. mosif alav kohen gadol, choshen veefod umeil vatzitz. beellu nishalin beurim vetummim. veen nishalin ella lammelech ulevet din ulemi shehatztzibbur tzarich bo:

8.1: Yom hakkippurim asur baachila uvishtiyya uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta. vehammelech vehakkalla yirchatzu et penehem, vehechaya tinol et hassandal, divre rabbi eliezer, vachachamim osrin:
8.2: Haochel kechotevet haggassa, kamoha uchegarinatah, vehashshote melo lugmav, chayyav. kol hoochalin mitztarfin lichchotevet. kol hammashkin mitztarfin limlo lugmav. haochel veshote, en mitztarfin:
8.3: Achal veshata behelem achat, eno chayyav ella chattat echat. achal veasa melacha, chayyav shete chattaot. achal ochalin sheenan reuyin laachila, veshata mashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya, veshata tzir o muryas, patur:
8.4: Hattinokot, en meannin otan beyom hakkippurim, aval mechannechin otam lifne shana velifne shenatayim, bishvil sheyyihyu regilin bammitzvot:
8.5: Ubbara shehericha, maachilin otah ad shettashiv nafshah. chole maachilin oto al pi vekiin. veim en sham bekiin, maachilin oto al pi atzmo, ad sheyyomar day:
8.6: Mi sheachazo vulmus, maachilin oto afillu devarim temeim, ad sheyyeoru enav. mi shenneshacho chelev shote, en maachilin oto mechatzar kaved shelo, verabbi matya ven charash mattir. veod amar rabbi matya ven charash, hachoshesh bigrono, mattilin lo sam betoch piv beshabbat, mippene shehu sefek nefashot, vechol sefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat:
8.7: Mi shennafla alav mappolet, safek hu sham safek eno sham, safek chay safek met, safek nachri safek yisrael, mefakkechin alav et haggal. metzauhu chay, mefakkechin alav. veim met, yannichuhu:
8.8: Chattat veasham vadday mechapperin. mita veyom hakkippurim mechapperin im hatteshuva. hatteshuva mechapperet al averot kallot al ase veal lo taase. veal hachamurot hi tola ad sheyyavo yom hakkippurim vichapper:
8.9: Haomer, echeta veashuv, echeta veashuv, en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva. echeta veyom hakkippurim mechapper, en yom hakkippurim mechapper. averot shebben adam lammakom, yom hakkippurim mechapper. averot shebben adam lachavero, en yom hakkippurim mechapper, ad sheyyeratztze et chavero. et zo darash rabbi elazar ben azarya, mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu (Vayikra 16), averot shebben adam lammakom, yom hakkippurim mechapper. averot shebben adam lachavero, en yom hakkippurim mechapper, ad sheyyeratztze et chavero. amar rabbi akiva, ashrechem yisrael, lifne mi attem mittaharin, umi metaher etchem, avichem shebbashshamayim, shenneemar (yechezkel lo), vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem. veomer (yirmeya 17), mikve yisrael Adonai, ma mikve metaher et hattemeim, af hakkadosh baruch hu metaher et yisrael:
